ops.text: A fresh git worktree off cc-context cannot `go build ./...` — three `go:embed` patterns (`formatcore.wasm`, `embedcore.wasm`, `grammars/*.wasm.gz`) reference gitignored build artifacts that only `task build`/`task test` generate via their `wasm`/`wasm-embed` deps, and a worktree starts without them. Every agent spawned into `.claude/worktrees/<lane>` hits this on its first build, and the failure mode is worse than a plain error: an agent that runs `go build ./... 2>&1 | tail` reads exit 0 from `tail`, not the compiler, and certifies a non-building tree as green — which happened here, and was only caught later when a real build was run unpiped. Two things would close it: have the `wasm`/`wasm-embed` task deps run (or the artifacts be copied/symlinked from the parent checkout) as part of whatever bootstraps a worktree, so a worktree is buildable the moment it exists; and treat a piped build/test as a reporting hazard in the guidance, since `cmd | tail` reports the pipeline's last exit status and silently discards a compiler or test failure. Copying the artifacts in from the parent checkout is the working remedy today, but nothing tells you that until the embed error appears.
